text:
elaine_king: Quick update — closed an ISV + marketplace deal with PulseHealth. They'll list Redwood Private on Azure Marketplace with a preconfigured deployment offer and signed a 2-year Dedicated commitment. Case study draft & assets up: https://confluence.redwood/pulsehealth-case-study and https://drive.redwood/pulsehealth-assets :tada:
jonas_park: Amazing news, congrats! What's the committed capacity and go-live window?
catalina_ruiz: Huge — any special compliance asks for the healthcare team? cc @ops-bot
elaine_king: Committed: 8x A100 reserved, with bursts up to 16. Go-live target: next Tue 09:00 PT. Legal already signed BAA and reviewed data flows.
ops-bot: Policy check: HIPAA BAA present and signed. Audit ticket #2345 created (owners: catalina_ruiz, jonas_park).
amy_chen: I'll draft the announcement copy and a short customer quote. Can someone share a metric we can call out?
elaine_king: PulseHealth saw ~3x latency improvement and ~40% cost per request reduction after migrating to our runtime in their beta. Put that in the case study draft.
liz_ortega: Can marketing get a high-res logo and a short quote from their CTO? I'll slot this into next-week social + newsletter if we have assets.
jonas_park: Eng-runtime — can we add a KV cache tuning flag for their Dedicated pool before launch? low-risk change but will help p99s.
catalina_ruiz: Noted. We'll do a canary on the dedicated pool and monitor privacy-related logs.
elaine_king: Assets uploaded to drive and confluence (links above). Sales confirmed a guaranteed minimum spend of $1.2M in year 1.
amy_chen: :party_parrot: I'll aim to have press-ready copy by tomorrow EOD. Need a customer quote + logo permissions.
liz_ortega: Timeline for public announcement? We should coordinate with Marketplace listing publication.
elaine_king: Target public announcement next Tue 09:00 PT (same as go-live). Legal gave high-level OK; final signoff Mon EOD.
jonas_park: Ops — prefer rollout window Fri 11pm PT for final deploy (lower traffic).
ops-bot: Scheduling poll posted in #release-war-room. Please vote.
catalina_ruiz: Shoutout to sales and solutions engineering for driving this. Big step for our healthcare vertical.
elaine_king: Thanks everyone — big win. If you need access to the case study or assets DM me. cc @sales-team @solutions :rocket:
